Cake Cobbler
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, February 11, 2010 - 8:53am

Ingredients




cup Margarine
cup Flour
teaspoon Salt
1 teaspoon Baking powder
1 cup Sugar
cup Milk
1 can Fruit, with juice

Preparation

1 Melt margarine in bottom of oblong cobbler pan. Empty can of fruit and juice into margarine,scattering evenly over the pan. Sift dry ingredients together. Add sugar and milk to dry ingredients. Mix until smooth. Pour over fruit. 2 Bake at 375F for 30-40 minutes. Sprinkle with cinnamon-sugar if desired and serve with nonfat dairy topping or ice cream.
